# Load Libraries and Data

```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(limma)
library(survival)
library(e1071)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Preparing

```{r}
# Load SKCM expression object
load("SKCM.rda")

# Extract clinical data
clinical <- colData(query2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(patient, gender, vital_status, days_to_death, 
         ajcc_pathologic_stage, age_at_diagnosis) %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = days_to_death / 365,
    event = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0),
    age_diagnosis = age_at_diagnosis / 365
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(survival_time) & !is.na(event))

# Log2 transform expression data
log_expr <- log2(assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand") + 1)

# Match samples between clinical and expression
matched_samples <- intersect(rownames(clinical), colnames(log_expr))
clinical <- clinical[matched_samples, ]
log_expr <- log_expr[, matched_samples]
```

# Feature Selection

```{r}
# Select top 1000 most variable genes
select_top_var_genes <- function(expr, n = 1000) {
  top_genes <- names(sort(apply(expr, 1, var), decreasing = TRUE))[1:n]
  return(top_genes)
}

# Select top 50 genes associated with survival using Cox p-values
select_surv_genes <- function(expr, time, event, n = 50) {
  pvals <- sapply(1:nrow(expr), function(i) {
    fit <- tryCatch(coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ expr[i,]), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(fit)) summary(fit)$coefficients[1, 5] else 1
  })
  names(pvals) <- rownames(expr)
  top_genes <- names(sort(pvals))[1:n]
  return(top_genes)
}

top_genes <- select_top_var_genes(log_expr, 1000)
log_expr_sub <- log_expr[top_genes, ]
surv_genes <- select_surv_genes(log_expr_sub, clinical$survival_time, clinical$event, 50)
expr_final <- t(log_expr[surv_genes, ])

# Combine expression and clinical data
svm_data <- as.data.frame(expr_final) %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = clinical$survival_time,
    event = clinical$event,
    gender = factor(clinical$gender),
    age_diagnosis = clinical$age_diagnosis,
    stage = factor(case_when(
      grepl("I", clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage) ~ "Early",
      grepl("II", clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage) ~ "Intermediate",
      grepl("III|IV", clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage) ~ "Advanced",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
  )
```

# Remove NA

```{r}
nzv <- nearZeroVar(svm_data %>% select(-survival_time, -event), names = TRUE)
svm_data <- svm_data[, setdiff(colnames(svm_data), nzv)]
```

# Split data

```{r}
set.seed(42)
idx_event <- which(svm_data$event == 1)
idx_censored <- which(svm_data$event == 0)

train_idx <- c(
  sample(idx_event, size = round(0.7 * length(idx_event))),
  sample(idx_censored, size = round(0.7 * length(idx_censored)))
)
test_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(svm_data)), train_idx)

train_data <- svm_data[train_idx, ]
train_data <- na.omit(train_data)
test_data <- svm_data[test_idx, ]
test_data <- na.omit(test_data)
```

# Train SVM Model

```{r}
predictors <- setdiff(colnames(train_data), c("survival_time", "event"))
form <- as.formula(paste("survival_time ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))

set.seed(42)
svm_model <- train(
  form,
  data = train_data,
  method = "svmRadial",
  preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
  trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5),
  tuneLength = 5
)

test_data$predicted <- predict(svm_model, newdata = test_data)
```

# Evaluate Model

```{r}
# C-index (survival concordance)
c_index <- concordance(Surv(test_data$survival_time, test_data$event) ~ test_data$predicted)$concordance

# AUC for 1-year mortality
test_data$surv_1yr <- with(test_data, ifelse(survival_time <= 1 & event == 1, 1, 0))
valid <- with(test_data, survival_time >= 1 | (survival_time < 1 & event == 1))
labels <- test_data$surv_1yr[valid]
scores <- test_data$predicted[valid]
valid_idx <- complete.cases(labels, scores)

roc_plot <- if (sum(valid_idx) > 10) {
  roc_obj <- pROC::roc(labels[valid_idx], scores[valid_idx], direction = "<")
  auc_val <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
  ggroc(roc_obj) + geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = "1-Year Mortality ROC (SVM)", subtitle = paste("AUC =", round(auc_val, 3))) +
    theme_minimal()
} else {
  ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Not enough samples for ROC") + theme_void()
}
```

# Visualizations

```{r}
# Predicted vs Actual
scatter_plot <- ggplot(test_data, aes(x = survival_time, y = predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Predicted vs Actual Survival Time", x = "Actual", y = "Predicted")

# Variable importance
varimp_plot <- tryCatch({
  vip <- varImp(svm_model)
  ggplot(vip$importance %>% head(20) %>% rownames_to_column("Feature"),
         aes(x = reorder(Feature, Overall), y = Overall)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") + coord_flip() + theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Top 20 Important Features (SVM)", x = "Feature", y = "Importance")
}, error = function(e) ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No varImp available") + theme_void())
```

# Table

```{r}
metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("C-index", "AUC (1yr)"),
  Value = c(round(c_index, 3), if (exists("auc_val")) round(auc_val, 3) else NA)
)
knitr::kable(metrics, caption = "SVM Model Performance")
```

# Display plots

```{r}
print(scatter_plot)
print(roc_plot)
print(varimp_plot)
```
